ns2:section.sectionText: Audiologists play an important role in the identification and management of individuals with vestibular disorders. The following topics are covered in the SHS 593 Vestibular Assessment and Rehabilitation class: anatomy and physiology of the vestibular system; common vestibular disorders and other causes of dizziness; bedside examination of the dizzy patient; administration and interpretation of vestibular tests including VNG and ENG; role of other medical professionals in the assessment and management of dizzy patients; vestibular rehabilitation. The course materials closely follow the assigned textbook.
